#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }
    
    std::vector<int> costs;
    int balance = 0;
    int prevBalance = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if ((a[i - 1] & 1) == 1) {
            ++balance;
        } else {
            --balance;
        }
        
        if (balance == prevBalance) {
            costs.push_back(std::abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
            prevBalance = balance;
        }
    }
    
    std::sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    
    int total = 0;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int c : costs) {
        if (total + c > b) break;
        total += c;
        ++ans;
    }
    
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
